commands.command: git clone --branch task/QA-001-coverage-and-skip-audit <repo> <empty dir> && QUANSIO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=<dev .env DSN> QUANSIO_CI_GATE_TIMEOUT=7200 bash scripts/ci/ci.sh # clean checkout at edf72d2, fresh target: 12 gates incl. contract-drift and the new test-audit
QUANSIO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=<dev .env DSN> python3.12 scripts/ci/coverage.py rust --out rust-lines-2.json # line-only instrumented workspace run (continuous profiles), 138 test binaries
QUANSIO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=<dev .env DSN> python3.12 scripts/ci/coverage.py rust --branch --out rust-branches-2.json # branch regions, reported
uv run --project python python scripts/ci/coverage.py python --out python.json # stdlib sys.monitoring tracer over the python/ suite
python3.12 scripts/ci/coverage.py check --rust rust-lines-2.json --rust-branches rust-branches-2.json --python python.json --out report-final.json # DOSSIER §21.4 floors
mutation/control runs: each regression's new test against its pre-fix source (RUN-009 startup recovery, RUN-011 refusal after dispatch, RUN-001 joined result and step budget, RUN-011 question expiry)
